A1.justification: Both 25-page PDFs describe OS-Genesis. Their main text, equations, figures, tables, Appendices A–G and prompt listings support a complete comparison.

before.justification: v2 reports original GUI-agent evaluations on AndroidControl, AndroidWorld and WebArena (Tables 1–2), alongside ablations and trajectory reward model validation.

after.justification: v3 retains these original benchmark evaluations, ablations and reward-model validation results, including the correlations in Appendix F.

M1.justification: The interaction-driven exploration, reverse task synthesis, trajectory reward model, sampling procedure and training objectives are identical.

E1.justification: Both versions use the same AndroidControl high- and low-level tasks, AndroidWorld environments and WebArena domains. No training or evaluation coverage is added or removed.

E2.justification: Tables 1–2 retain identical zero-shot, task-driven and self-instruction comparators. The reward-model and human-data comparisons in Section 5 and Appendix F also retain their comparator sets.

E3.justification: Model configurations, training-data budgets, metrics and testing procedures are unchanged, including the 112 AndroidWorld tasks and 241 WebArena tests documented in Appendix A.

E4.justification: Section 5 retains the same diversity analysis, reward-model ablation, data-scaling study and human-data comparisons. The supplementary scoring-alignment and diversity analyses in Appendices F–G also match.

E5.justification: Both retain the same Spearman-correlation and p-value reporting in Appendix F. No run-count, seed, confidence-interval or other uncertainty-reporting information is added or revised.

E6.justification: All reported results match, including Tables 1–2, Figures 4–8, the correlations in Tables 5–6 and the instruction-length and trajectory-length statistics in Appendix G.

T1.justification: The task-synthesis mappings, reward-based sampling mathematics in Algorithm 1 and training losses in Equations 1–2 are unchanged. No formal assumptions, derivations or proofs are added.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction and conclusion retain identical claims about automated trajectory construction, data quality and diversity, and improved GUI-agent performance.

C2.justification: The interpretations of diversity, reward modeling, scaling and human-data comparisons are unchanged. The limitations concerning proprietary models, multimodal data use and trajectory-construction capacity are also identical.

D1.justification: Hardware, model settings, accessibility-tree preprocessing and training, evaluation and reward-model prompts are unchanged. Code, data and checkpoint access information also remains the same.

R1.justification: The related-work discussion, research positioning and bibliography contain the same works and statements. Reference movement across pages does not add or remove citations.

P1.justification: The acknowledgement adds WYNG Foundation support (AR25AG100407) alongside Shanghai Artificial Intelligence Laboratory and changes 'work' to 'research'. The arXiv version/date stamp is updated; other prose is unchanged.

P2.justification: The expanded acknowledgement continues into the right column on page 10, shifting Author Contributions and reference placement across pages 10–13. Figures, tables, captions and appendix layouts remain unchanged.

improvement.justification: v3 adds funding attribution and introduces limited layout and version-stamp edits. The scientific content, supporting evidence, limitations and reproducibility information remain identical throughout the main text and appendices, establishing no meaningful overall quality difference.
